title: AI agent helped Microsoft executive save 14% on vacation rental
excerpt: A Microsoft executive used an AI agent to find the same Airbnb property on its own website and book directly for less.
content_html:
A Microsoft executive showed how AI agents can help travelers avoid Airbnb fees

By Alistair Barr

You're currently following this author! Click to unsubscribe from email alerts.

Author of the AI Insider newsletter

Here's a clever way to save money on your next vacation rental. And it shows how AI agents can make everyday tasks easier.

Nicolas Bustamante, an AI executive at Microsoft, recently shared a trick on X that saved his family 14% on an Airbnb booking.

Before paying, he asked an AI agent to search the web for the same property on its own website. The agent found it, checked availability for the same dates, and discovered that booking directly was cheaper.

This isn't a new trick. Savvy travelers have long found properties they like on Airbnb or Vrbo, then searched the web to find the exact same rental and book directly with the owner. That can save both travelers and hosts the fees charged by these platforms.

AI agents make this process more seamless by doing the searching and comparing for you.

That's potentially bad news for Airbnb and Vrbo, but good news for travelers and hosts.

Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky says agents are barely making any bookings on his platform. Maybe that's because they're booking elsewhere, Brian.
